description: This file defines the Mail entity class used within the OrangeHRM system. It models the database table 'ohrm_mail_queue' and contains properties and methods to manage email queue entries such as recipients, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing email messages queued for sending in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for recipients, subject, content, timestamps, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the mail record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the mail record.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of 'To' email addresses.

methods.name: setToList
methods.description: Sets the list of 'To' email addresses.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of 'CC' email addresses.

methods.name: setCcList
methods.description: Sets the list of 'CC' email addresses.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of 'BCC' email addresses.

methods.name: setBccList
methods.description: Sets the list of 'BCC' email addresses.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Gets the email subject.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the email subject.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the email body content.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the email body content.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the email was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for email creation.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: setSentAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the email (pending, started, sent, failed).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the email, validating allowed status values.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the email (plain text or HTML).

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the email, validating allowed values.
